## Plan{.smaller}

- Use your github account and the github.com IDE
- Fork the repository `https://github.com/vjcitn/lovequarto` into your organization
- Use the IDE editing feature to change the title to use your own name
- Commit the changes with a comment describing what you did
- Create a new Rstudio project with the version control option
- use `https://github.com/[your org name]/lovequarto` to seed the project
- "run" the chkshiny.qmd "document" and we will explore it together
